articleTitle: Applications of Chi-Square Test and Contingency Table Analysis in Customer Satisfaction and Empirical Analyses
abstract: In this paper, theories of Chi-square test of multinomial distribution and contingency table analysis, and their applications in customer satisfaction are introduced, and empirical analyses are carried out.

articleTitle: E-Government Grid System Based on Multi-agent for Interoperability
abstract: In this paper, we present e-government grid system to provide the seamless services to the public. The main goal of e-government systems is to promote the accessibility of government's information created by the various processing among the public sectors. The needs of sharing data and processes from the legacy systems are currently increased. However, it is difficult to convert the interoperable infrastructure from distributed and independent legacy systems in governments. Further, it requires more cost, labor and times to gain the advantages from the legacy. In this paper, we suggest the grid based integrated environments to use the distributed legacy systems in ease, as to solve the issued problems. The grid environments consist of a set of grid-middleware that connects to database and systems. The grid-middleware should be light-weight and flexible to guarantee the integrity of the independent legacy systems. Therefore we describe the middleware based on the multi-agents and consequently show data interoperation from e-government grid system through the integration of legacy systems. It is expected to reduce cost and time, as well as easily builds the cooperating environments on government's legacy systems.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of CDIO Model Teachers' Classroom Teaching Quality Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
abstract: CDIO model is the latest achievement in the international engineering education reform, it is centralized summarization and abstract expression of learning by doing and Project based education and learning. AHP and Fuzzy judgement was used the evaluation system of CDIO model teachers' classroom teaching quality. By analyzing constituent elements of teaching quality, teaching attitude, teaching method, teaching content and teaching effectiveness was proposed as index system, on the basis of experts' knowledge and subjective experience, the subjective element was removed as much as possible by using marigorous logic mathematical methods, index weights was determined by using AHP, the model was established by using Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. The evaluation results can reflect the management of teaching quality more objectively, so as to provide a new way for evaluation of CDIO model teachers' classroom teaching quality, thus it has theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of Modern Green Logistics in China
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the quantity of logistics activities in China increases quickly. Logistics activities brought serious negative impact on the environment. Therefore, the green logistics will become the trend of the current logistics. This paper first analyses the necessary of green logistics, then analyses the developing actuality of the green logistics in China, and also proposes some strategies to develop the green logistics from the government, the enterprises, consumers and the industry associations' point of view respectively.

articleTitle: Technology Incubator Performance in New Zealand
abstract: Business incubation and technology incubation is an area where new ideas are combined with resources and expertise in order to produce viable products and businesses. The business and technology incubation sector in New Zealand is relatively young compared to the United States and a government program administered by New Zealand Trade and Enterprise provides assistance to incubators by way of government assistance programs and targeted funding. Administration of the program requires incubators that are recipients of government funding provide information on their performance so that New Zealand Trade and Enterprise can assess the performance of the incubation programs. From this data a return on investment analysis is taken which provides indicators of the effectiveness of the incubation program. Due to the newness of the incubation programs in New Zealand, a limited amount of performance metrics are compiled for a comparative analysis. The paper presents performance indicators of the technology and business incubation programs supported by New Zealand Trade and Enterprise and discusses future metrics for a more detailed analysis of performance.

articleTitle: An Improved Estimation Algorithm of Symbol Synchronization for QAM Signal
abstract: For the contradiction between accuracy and data size, this paper introduces an improved estimation algorithm of symbol synchronization based on the maximum mean power estimation algorithm. A Deslauriers-Dubuc interpolation filter is used in the improved algorithm. Analysis of experimental results showed that the estimation algorithm proposed in this paper not only improves the accuracy of estimate, but also has a smaller calculation that facilitates the implementation of low-complexity.

articleTitle: Organizational Core Competencies and Network Knowledge Management
abstract: In this paper, review the organization's core competitiveness, research results, based on the characteristics of the core competitiveness of the analysis leads to the core knowledge as its basis, and is defined as network-based knowledge. Web-based knowledge with the support of the main features of the core competitive edge, it would become the core competitiveness of evolutionary source of inspiration. Organization to maintain its core competencies must be found to maintain and rational use of web-based knowledge.

articleTitle: An Overview of Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm and Its Application on Production Scheduling
abstract: This paper analyses the type and characteristics of several typical production scheduling problems, including multiprocessor scheduling, flow shop scheduling, job shop scheduling and flexible job shop scheduling. It reviews improved ant colony algorithm and its application on several scheduling problems, and the characteristics of the improved strategy. Finally, the development trend and existence problems of production scheduling are discussed.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Robust Design Method for Product Quality
abstract: The robust parameter design is effective method that is to produce high quality product at low cost to the manufacturer. This paper analyses disadvantages of Taguchi quality method, of which the amount of calculation is increased, algorithm is complicated, and the optimal value of variables in parameter design is updated in regression analysis. Having discovered a lot of useful information not to be utilized in Taguchi quality method, this paper introduces a new robust design method based on orthogonal optimization and variance ratio analysis. The optimal values of parameter and tolerance, at one time, can be obtained by means of successive-orthogonal arrays and variance ratio analysis in parameter design. The best solution in last orthogonal arrays and its tolerance selected by variance ratio analysis make up of factors in successive-orthogonal arrays. The bigger is variance ratio in last orthogonal arrays, the smaller is forecast range of tolerance in successive-orthogonal arrays. It is not necessary to make tolerance design after parameter design and to use crossed array design, signal-to-noise ratio analysis and regression analysis. Numerical result shows that the new method is far simpler and more convenient than Taguchi quality method.

articleTitle: Research on the Movement Model and Predictive Compensation of a Precision Locating System Driven by VCM
abstract: This in order to overcoming the disadvantages of the traditional precision locating system, this paper shows A precision locating System Driven by VCM(Voice Coil Motor). The coupling characteristics of the mechanical and electrical systems of the locating is thoroughly analyzed, and the transfer function model is founded. The three predictive compensation method is used to cut down the error of the locating, and the fuzzy predictive compensation is experimented to be best.

articleTitle: Shortwave Memory Power Amplifier Linearization Based on Tanh Neural Network Predistorter
abstract: Shortwave power amplifiers (PAs) are usually considered as memoryless devices in most existing predistortion techniques. Nevertheless, in shortwave communication systems, PA memory effects can no longer be ignored and memoryless predistortion cannot linearize PAs effectively. By analyzing the characteristics of the power amplifier, an improved predistortion method for memory power amplifier is presented. The Tanh neural network predistorter is used, and its parameters have been adjusted adaptively using an indirect learning architecture. Simulation results show that inter modulation component suppression and compensation for memory effect of power amplifiers have been improved.

articleTitle: Study on Methods of Knowledge Domain Visualization
abstract: This paper discusses theoretical basis and realizing methods of knowledge domain visualization(KDViz). Visualization of knowledge domain is a kind of technology to extract structural patterns from scientific literatures and express them in 2D or 3D knowledge space, namely, the visualization on intellectual structure of some knowledge domain. This paper not only systematically introduces the concept and theoretical basis of visualization of knowledge domain, but also presents its application model and performs case analysis.

articleTitle: Design for Emergency Command System on Flood Control and Fight
abstract: The damage of flood has nature of outburst. When the damage happens, doing rescue and relief work is the most important responsibility of government on all levels. Based on the developing of the electronic emergency command system with efficient and high-speed responding capability, the principle of flood control and fight, organization of nation flood control and fight command system and position of all department and responsibility were introduced; the function requirement of preventing and preventing alarm, responding emergency, reporting and dealing of information, command and movement, release of information and communication, establishing of resource data base in flood control and fight emergency system were emphatically analyzed; the structure of system in flood control and fight emergency system was designed; the manner of information encryption transmission in emergency system was explored; the system model and encryption algorithm of information transmission was given in detail. Obtain a satisfaction effect during the application of the system.

articleTitle: Study of CPD in Manufacturing Supply Chain towards Knowledge and Service Management
abstract: This paper analyzed the main features of product design and manufacturing in the knowledge management environment and service oriented management model based on collaborative. Based on the analysis of these two aspects, this paper puts forward the four key problems which the collaborative design activities in manufacturing supply chain will face in knowledge representation and knowledge converting and knowledge reuse and knowledge management. At last, a framework for collaborative product design(CPD) knowledge management model in manufacturing supply chain based on ontology is established under the application background of integrated platform for collaborative product design in manufacturing enterprise.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 3-Dimension Visualization System of Primary Wheat Diseases
abstract: On the basis of understanding and grasping the occurrence condition, popularity season, key impact factors for main wheat diseases of stripe rust, head blight and powdery mildew from research material and literature, 3D visualization model system for wheat growth, development and yield formation, which got wheat growth dynamic data from simulation model with a day as time step, was implemented. The occurrence discipline and evolution model of these diseases was designed. The model system could not only help the user understand the principle of wheat growth and diseases occurrence better, but also express the process of growth, development and disease evolution obviously and intuitively. The diseases diagnosis and visualization give decision-maker favorable suggestion on diseases prevention, and will help farmer, technician and decision-maker to use crop growth simulation model better and provide decision-making support. Now the visualization model for primary wheat diseases is in the process of development.

articleTitle: Land Subsidence Numerical Simulation of Taiyuan City
abstract: In this paper, an integrated model was established for Taiyuan area using the modular finite difference groundwater flow model, MODFLOW (McDonald and Harbaugh, 1988), combined with Interbed Storage Package-1 were adopted to simulate transient groundwater flow and ground consolidation. The simulated results show that subsidence rapidly occurs throughout the area as groundwater over-exploitation continues. Sensitivity analysis indicates that certain hydrogeologic parameters such as inelastic storage coefficient of soil layers significantly affect both the rate and magnitude of consolidation. Land subsidence occurred in places where groundwater was drawn in great volumes, and land subsidence centers matches well with groundwater declining centers, and likewise the rate of land subsidence has positive correlation with the rate of groundwater level decline. In addition, the integrated numerical model was capable of forecasting the regional trend of groundwater level and land subsidence.

articleTitle: The Optimal Pricing Model of Commission of China's Futures Exchange: Competition-Oriented or Cost-Oriented
abstract: Commission pricing of futures exchange is a very important issue. Based on economics Bertrand oligopoly model, we proposed the optimal pricing model of commission of China's futures exchange. Though the study we found that the optimal pricing strategy of commission of China's futures exchange is the enterprise self oriented cost strategy. Analyzing the futures market transaction data, we investigated the effect of commission adjustments on futures exchange, through which to examine customers' sensitivity to exchange commission.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining in Classification Analysis of Safety Accidents Based on Alternate Covering Neural Network
abstract: Application of alternate covering neural network in data mining is given to the classification algorithms, which overcome the continuous iteration and local minimum of traditional neural network algorithms. The calculation speed is high and it is able to adapt to high-dimensional data classification well. Through case study, intuitive geometric significance of alternate covering is used to structure classification. Comparing with BP neural network algorithm and the decision tree algorithm, it is not iterative and without local minimum, which improves the speed and accuracy of classification. It is concluded that the alternative covering neural network uses parallel processing capability which can achieve rapid calculation in order to adapt to data mining applications.

articleTitle: Application of Grey Neural Network in Analyzing Disaster Prevention and Control in Coal Mine Based on CC and RBF-DDA Algorithms
abstract: Prevention and control of the disastrous accident is the top priority of coal mine production safety. RBF and the combined grey neural network (CGNN) model are established. Combined with cascade-correlation (CC) and RBF-DDA algorithms, gas explosion impacting on coal mine production safety largely is analyzed. The analysis results show that gas explosion accident is caused by many reasons. The relationship between coal mine production and safety needs to be effectively coordinated. It is concluded that, at the beginning, CC and RBF-DDA algorithms are used to structure the initial hidden nodes to zero. Through the training process, the hidden units are added in the light of adaptive algorithm constantly. These units are of a higher classification accuracy and robustness, which, in the future, provides the basis for the deep application and study in coal mine safety and production.

articleTitle: Thinking and Suggestion on Promoting the Trade of SO_2 Pollution Right
abstract: Sulfur dioxide is a kind of poisonous and harmful gas, and will pollute atmosphere environment if exhaust it directly. There are a lot of treatment methods so far. In this paper, it summarizes the main ideas and main characteristics, as well as the necessity for carrying out the discharge right which is used to solve the sulfur dioxide pollution and proposes the design logos of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> pollution discharge right in accordance with China's national conditions.

articleTitle: Desulfurization Performance Study on Many Kinds of Load-Modification Fly Ash
abstract: Sulfur dioxide is a kind of toxic and harmful gas, and will pollute atmosphere environment if exhausted directly. There are a lot of desulfurization methods so far. The desulfurization efficiency including many kinds of fly ash containing bag dust remover, electric dust remover and wet dust remover mixed with calcium hydroxide in the same mixture ratio, same hydrogen temperature and same hydrogen time is studied in this paper. The results indicate that the desulfurization efficiency between the modification fly gas with bag dust remover and with electric one is similar, and they are more efficient than wet dust remover, but less efficient than activated carbon. Meanwhile, the desulfurization mechanism of modification fly gas is analyzed briefly in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Practice Progress about Information Service Institution Establishment during Transformation
abstract: This paper applied literature investigation method to collect documentaries from different areas related to information service institution design, service management, operating mechanism, international communication and cooperation etc. It has tracked the directions of research and got to know the experts and scholars research perspective and research progress. With a comprehensive studying on the development of the information service institution construction, the problems in the information service institution establishing process has been found out and institutional analyzed, and the direction of further research has been advised.

articleTitle: Decision Making of Construction Method Based on Fuzzy TOPSIS
abstract: As a group decision making issue, construction method decision-making is crucial to water conservancy project, however, there are many qualitative, fuzzy and imprecision information in construction method evaluation process that are main difficulties for decision makers. As for the traditional evaluation method, it only depends on designers experience to do evaluation at discretion and has no systematical evaluation framework. The gist of this paper is to propose a systematical approach based on fuzzy linguistic to solve design and planning evaluation issue that includes not only quantitative computation but also qualitative analysis, it could be an effective method for construction method decision making.

articleTitle: A Study on the Roughness with Extra Fine Sediment in Open Channel
abstract: In view of the abnormal phenomenon that a flood peak increased in August 2004 and July 2005 along the lower Yellow River, the mechanism of this abnormal phenomenon is studied. It is found that the flood increase was due to the decrease the channel roughness in the propagation of high concentrated flood carrying the extra fine sediment which was discharged from Xiaolangdi reservoir. Then the experiment with extra fine sediment flowing smooth, roughness beds was studied. Based on the comparison between the distributions of velocity and the analysis of resistance in the experiment, the results show that resistance of flow may be considerably reduced by the extra fine sediment if the flow boundary is rough. It has the significant value for the flood control and flood prediction.

articleTitle: Study of Knowledge-Based Dynamic Consistency upon Employee Performance Standards
abstract: Knowledge-based staff and the general staff in performance management are very different, knowledge-based employee performance evaluation more complicated, greater uncertainty. Enterprises in the development of performance standards, are often unable to maintain its dynamic consistency, easy to make knowledge workers to the entire cast doubt on the performance of the evaluation process, thus weakening their passion for work, is finally unable to achieve the desired performance management results. This paper uses game theory analysis of the relevant knowledge proof of knowledge workers to maintain performance standards for the necessity of dynamic consistency, and performance evaluation of maintaining dynamic consistency recommendations.

articleTitle: Correction Model of Pressure Sensor Based on Support Vector Machine
abstract: The temperature and voltage fluctuation characteristics of pressure sensor was analyzed and found that the sensor output is nonlinear and easy to be affected by temperature and voltage fluctuation over a wide measuring range, a correction model of pressure sensor based on Support Vector Machine was presented. The approximate ability of the SVM to any nonlinear function was utilized to drill the correction model. so as to enable it to be setup at different temperatures and voltage fluctuation, thus allowing the sensor output can be in a nonlinear mapping relation to the voltage values the sensor actually sensed. The experimental results showed that the max comes down from 22.2% for 0.64%; the model can not only eliminate the influence of temperature fluctuation and voltage fluctuation but obtain the expected linear output from the output terminal of correction model.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Continuous Data Protection Technology in E-Commerce System
abstract: This paper analyzes data characteristics and storage requirements of E-Commerce System, compares the technological characteristics, key technology & implementation models of the current continuous data protection, and puts forward a renovated implementation model for continuous data protection, which can serve as reference in data protection.

articleTitle: Open-Loop and Closed-Loop Differential Duopolistic Models of Optimal Sticky Prices and Advertising in Product Differentiation Market
abstract: This paper develops a differential duopolistic game model of optimal sticky prices and advertising in product differentiation market, and investigates the properties of open-loop, and closed-loop memoryless Nash equilibrium. Specifically, we have made two contributions with respect to the available literature. First, we have proposed the new assumption of the price adjustment speed is decided by the goodwill levels that are composed of consumer preference structure, the levels of the product differentiation and advertising expenditures, which extend the assumptions in existing literature. Second, we have analyzed the case of the closed-loop (memoryless) solution concept, in addition to the open-loop solution. We show that the latter equilibrium entails a larger level of steady state production as compared to the former; both equilibriums entail a larger level of production in steady state than the static Cournot game.

articleTitle: Rotor Position Simulation of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Fuzzy Inference Rules
abstract: A non-linear mathematical model of switched reluctance motor is established, Based on the analysis of the relationship between ¿-I-¿ curve of motor, A new type of indirect rotor position estimation method using fuzzy inference rules is designed. The paper adopted MATLAB6.1 as a simulation tool, used for the simulation of fuzzy inference rules of rotor position angle, The simulation result shows that: Angle of rotor position measured changes continuously and smoothly in the required scope, The estimated results is very good.

articleTitle: Application of DM in E-Government Based on Combined Grey Neural Network
abstract: Using grey system, satisfaction mining (DM) technology and radial basis function (RBF) neural network method, the combined model of grey system and RBF neural network is setup, which aims at solving the problems of E-government. The results show that, in short-term prediction, grey system is an effective way and RBF has perfect ability to study. The combined grey neural network (CGNN) has the dual properties of trend and fluctuation under the condition of combining with the time-dependent sequence satisfaction. It is concluded that great improvement comparing with any methods of trend prediction and simple factor in CGNN is stated and described in E-government.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Input and Output Efficiency in Different Agencies in China Based on Data Envelopment Analysis
abstract: In this paper, we use DEA-based method to build a relatively cutting-edge efficiency input-output function to distinguish between different agencies. Through the comparison on the efficiency of four different agencies, the results show that: colleges and universities, businesses and other sectors are weak DEA validity, and scientific research institutes for the DEA is invalid Comparisons of input-output efficiency shows: the most efficient institutions is colleges and universities, followed by other institutions, enterprises and R & D institutions. Several suggestions and explanations were proposed to improve efficiency according to the calculating results.

articleTitle: Gray Level Analysis Based on Gray Numerical Model of Air Pollution in Handan City
abstract: Because of the uncertainty problem of pollutants diffusing in the atmosphere of Handan city, we monitor and put forward a new conception about air ground pollution belt, and get two-dimensional finite difference equation of air pollution. Meanwhile dispersion coefficient and wind speed are considered as grey parameters. One grey numerical quality model of air pollution is built according to grey theory and applies to the air pollution diffusing system of Handan city. Meantime analyze the important impact factors of the gray level. The results show the dispersion coefficient gray level, the wind speed gray level and the attenuation coefficient gray level can influence the concentration gray level.

articleTitle: Research and Practical Progress of Information Service Transformation in China
abstract: This paper has gone through the researches and practical progresses of information service transformation in China in the way of documentation analysis. Based on the contents of information service environment, information service organization, information service mode and information service strategy etc. it has summarized the already got achievements and made further thinking. So, in this paper, the author pointed out that the general trend of modern information service transformation development is multi-factor participants, more industrialized service, diversified modes and market-oriented operation. Nowadays information service transformation theory researches are falling behind the practical progress; and the information service agencies' reform is also lack of plan. So, in future research, systematical information service transformation theory should be established so as to guide the information service practices.

articleTitle: Business Process Integration Technique Based on BOM
abstract: All enterprise management business processes are reflected in BOM, and operated through BOM. How to effectively express product BOM structure, and to apply BOM management techniques to adapt products to the high demand of quality are pivotal to successful business operation. This paper studies data organization and management of BOM through various stages of business operations, proposes a unified BOM skeleton model, achieves automatic conversion of BOM to ensure consistency, and provides a unified BOM method and technique for enterprise production management business process integration.

articleTitle: Perceived Organizational Support, Job Satisfaction, and the Retention of Employees after Industry Restructuring
abstract: Through one study which collected data from Chinese telecommunication industry, a conceptual model of the relationship between perceived organizational support, job satisfaction and employees' intention to remain with their organization after industry restructuring was tested. It concluded that implementing training and development practice, offering promotion opportunities and providing interesting and meaningful jobs are important to perceptions of organizational support and job satisfaction which ultimately lead to the retention of employees after industry restructuring.
